articles.title: UP Board exam result 2026 likely to be declared soon: Check complete details here
articles.summary: UPMSP is likely to declare the UP Board Class 10 and 12 compartment results 2026 by late August. The supplementary exams were held on July 28 for students seeking another chance to clear failed subjects.

articles.title: When will UGC NET 2026 provisional answer key be released? Here's what we know so far
